points.description: Names most of the three steps of anaerobic digestion: hydrolysis, acidogenesis, methanogenesis (at least two of the three correctly given, any wording or order).
points.partial_credit: 1 mark if only one step is correctly named.

rubric.notes: Full marks for naming at least two of the three steps (hydrolysis, acidogenesis, methanogenesis), in any order; minor spelling errors are fine. Give 1 mark for one correct step. No marks if none are correct. Extra wrong remarks do not cost marks unless they replace the correct steps.
